headline: Imad has the Wirtz —
Umar just has the name
body: Wirtz scored, assisted and took max bonus for 13. He plays for Heung Min Dad. Wirtz Case Scenario just has his name on the badge.
The top two both scored 51, so the lead stays at 32. Mitoma, signed for this week, watched from the bench injured. Imad didn't need him. That's the scary part.

headline: Third week running —
wrong keeper again
body: Kinsky started and got 2. Verbruggen sat on the bench and got 6. Three weeks in a row the backup has outscored the starter. At this point it's a hobby.
Credit where it's due: Le Fée 11, Dewsbury-Hall 9, 51 overall. Exactly what Imad scored, so the gap is still 32. Running to stand still.

headline: Vuskovic: 12 —
Gonzalo: 2, again
body: Vuskovic got 12, and Branthwaite, fished out of Imad's bin, chipped in 3. Third place, 18 clear of Vidhun.
Gonzalo kept his shirt and got 2 again. Awoniyi, benched again, also got 2. For once Rihab's striker call cost him nothing, mostly because there was nothing to win.

headline: Last week: nobody's hotter —
this week: 35
body: We said nobody was hotter, and he scored 35, second-lowest of the week. Thiago managed -2, which takes effort.
N. Jackson got 11 and Gabriel 8, or it would have been worse. Fourth place is now held by a single point over Split the G FC. Vidhun has gone very quiet.

headline: Barry 16 —
one point off fourth
body: Barry scored two, set up another and took max bonus against Coventry: 16, the best haul in the league this week. Muharemović added 10.
Then there's the Flemming saga. Out for Welbeck, back in for Welbeck, and this week he sat on the bench for 0. Fourth place is 1 point away. Time to get off the merry-go-round.

headline: 59, best in the league —
and up to sixth
body: Last week McGinn got 0 and Cherki got 1. This week: 10 and 9. Three starters didn't play, the bench covered for another 12, and nobody scored more.
Even the bad trade evened out. He dropped Bruno Fernandes for McGinn, and this week Bruno got 10 for Sandaru. McGinn: also 10. Dulaj is the one looking over his shoulder now.

headline: 49 points —
and still went down a place
body: Delap scored twice against Man City for 13, Ødegaard got 11, and Dulaj still dropped to seventh because Munir picked this week to score 59.
Last week all three strikers got 2. This week Delap went off, and Calvert-Lewin kept the tradition alive with 2. Still no waiver claims, by the way. The password reset is in his spam.

headline: Defence: 29 —
the front two: 1
body: Roefs 9, Konsa 8, Castagne 7. Keeper and back four made 29. Up front, Igor Jesus and Solanke made 1 between them.
The two new signings also made 1 between them, Khusanov on the pitch and Acheampong on the bench. Castagne, a GW9 claim, is the one that worked. Speed dating does sometimes get a second date.

headline: Lowest score of the week —
10 points sat on the bench
body: Lammens started in goal and got 1. Trafford sat on the bench and got 10. A nine-point keeper call on a 34-point week, the lowest in the league.
The waiver move was Matheus N., the defender Sandaru threw back a week earlier. He got 1. The gap to Sandaru in last is down to 7, and Samithu has noticed.

headline: Still last —
but the gap is halved
body: Last week he was 14 adrift. Now it's 7. Both new signings started: Bruno Fernandes got 10 and Kluivert 3.
Bruno was Munir's cast-off, so this is the rare waiver that worked out for everyone. Isak got 8, and Costinha got 6 on the bench, because nothing goes fully right down here.
